issues.message: The word limit for the email task is too restrictive and does not allow for a proper development of ideas.
issues.suggestedAction: Increase the word limit to at least 120-150 words.

issues.message: The article task may be too challenging for B1 level students, as it requires a higher level of writing proficiency.
issues.suggestedAction: Review the task instructions and adjust the language and requirements to better suit the B1 level.

issues.message: The story task may not be the best fit for the B1 level, as it requires a higher level of creative writing skills.
issues.suggestedAction: Consider replacing the story task with a more suitable genre, such as a descriptive essay or a short report.
